lines: Don't leave me near the Cold Ocean. That water bites hard enough without me facing it alone.
The Cold Ocean is no place to lose track of each other. One bad slip and I am done for.
I waited by the Cold Ocean trying to ignore how quickly that wind chills through me.
If you disappear beside a Cold Ocean, all I can think about is freezing before help returns.
The Cold Ocean does not give second chances. Please do not make me wait there alone again.
I kept looking at the water, wondering how fast it would take the warmth from me.
Next time we pass a Cold Ocean, stay where I can see you.
The wind off that water made every minute feel longer than it was.
I can handle cold. I cannot handle being forgotten in it.
Being left beside the Cold Ocean made me feel very small, and very far from safe.
I stayed beside the ice-dark water because the wind cut straight through my clothes.
I tried following you, but spray wiped your trail from the shore.
Alone in Cold Ocean, once my hands went numb, I stopped wandering and waited where you had last seen me.
I found a ridge of packed snow and kept out of the wind until you came back.
While I waited in Cold Ocean, the cold made it hard to think, and being alone made every choice feel worse.
After you vanished in Cold Ocean, I called your name twice, then saved my breath when only the wind answered.
By dusk I was stamping my feet just to keep feeling in them. I was still alone in Cold Ocean.
If we cross Cold Ocean again, tell me before you change direction.
If we get separated in Cold Ocean again, next time, leave a torch or a block trail when the snow starts hiding our route.
I can travel through Cold Ocean, but I need to know you are still traveling with me.

I kept thinking about what would happen if I slipped, and none of the answers were good.
